description: The main window: core defaults, plus native HTTP for subscription URLs. The HTTP scope is any http(s) URL because a subscription link is arbitrary user input (a remote panel, or a local converter on localhost), exactly as on Android, where CapacitorHttp has no scope at all. The URL is also checked in shared/src/core/subscription.ts before the request is made. Certificate validation cannot be disabled: the plugin's dangerous-settings feature is not compiled in.
